_comment: Farming Simulator 25 egg for the Pelican-specific FS25 image.
name: Farming Simulator 25
author: DasEric@users.noreply.github.com
description: Farming Simulator 25 dedicated server with Wine 11, noVNC installation, persistent game data and sequential DLC installation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server/game /mnt/server/config /mnt/server/installer /mnt/server/dlc /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/Desktop

echo "FS25 data directories are ready."

variables.name: VNC password
variables.description: Password for noVNC/VNC; at least six characters.

variables.name: VNC geometry
variables.description: Virtual desktop resolution.

variables.name: Web username
variables.description: GIANTS web administration username.

variables.name: Web password
variables.description: GIANTS web administration password.

variables.name: Web port
variables.description: Any additional allocation for the GIANTS web interface. It must differ from the primary game port.

variables.name: noVNC port
variables.description: Additional allocation used by the browser-based noVNC desktop.

variables.name: Web dark mode
variables.description: Load the optional community dark theme in the GIANTS web interface.

variables.name: Public IP or hostname
variables.description: Address displayed in console links.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the FS25 server browser.

variables.name: Game password
variables.description: Password used by players.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: In-game administrator password.

variables.name: Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players.

variables.name: Game port
variables.description: Primary allocation used by the Farming Simulator 25 game server.

variables.name: Region/language
variables.description: GIANTS server language code.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Leave empty to choose and retain the map in the GIANTS web interface. A value here forces this mapID on every container start.

variables.name: Savegame slot
variables.description: Savegame slot 1-20.

variables.name: Pause when empty
variables.description: 2 pauses while empty; 1 keeps running.

variables.name: Autosave interval
variables.description: Autosave interval in seconds.

variables.name: Statistics interval
variables.description: Statistics interval in seconds.

variables.name: Crossplay
variables.description: Allow cross-platform players.

variables.name: Autostart
variables.description: false keeps only the desktop online; web_only starts the GIANTS web interface; true also starts the game server.

variables.name: Auto-launch installer
variables.description: Start an uploaded installer automatically on boot.

variables.name: Wine audio
variables.description: disabled avoids ALSA device failures in a headless Wings container.

variables.name: Installer mode
variables.description: silent uses the unattended installer flags; interactive shows the installer in noVNC.

variables.name: Installer timeout
variables.description: Maximum installer runtime in seconds.

variables.name: Installer progress interval
variables.description: Seconds between installer progress messages.

variables.name: Activation timeout
variables.description: Maximum time in seconds for the interactive FS25 license activation.

variables.name: Run activation after install
variables.description: Launch FS25 once for license activation after setup.

variables.name: DLCs automatisch installieren
variables.description: After game installation/activation, launch every missing DLC installer in sequence. Product keys are entered manually in noVNC.

variables.name: DLC installer timeout
variables.description: Maximum interactive runtime per DLC installer in seconds.
